decision: Explicit synthetic behavior and stipulated rules are retained as regression material only. Two domain vocabularies share one conditional-rule template; no independent mechanism or new method effectiveness is established. No model dispatch.
question: Given explicit behavior facts, can an evaluator distinguish responsibility conformance, divergence, an applicable exception, and missing exception conditions under a supplied normative contract?
purpose: Development diagnostics for normative applicability, not architecture optimization, Rust behavior extraction, real violation detection or method novelty

inputs.source: Researcher-constructed contracts with explicitly supplied behavior facts; never presented as xkernel provider-approved requirements

admission_gates: Independent source review of prior methods; explicitly state reproduction versus adaptation
Reviewer checks each constructed contract entails a unique bounded reference outcome or explicit unknown; this is specification review, not independent real-world truth
Freeze input packets, reference ledger, hashes, output schema and evaluator before any model answers
Separate development examples from future held-out mechanism families; changing names alone is not a new independent family
Do not execute until model/agent identity, invocation policy, repetition count and exact packet budget are recorded
A missing fact must not be interpreted as a negative fact; an absent exception condition produces conditional branches when it affects the answer

comparison_design.primary: Full supplied contract, explicit behavior facts and condition evidence
comparison_design.deletion_control: Delete only exception-condition evidence for applicable-exception cases; the supplied-evidence reference becomes unknown, while hidden-world status is not used to penalize abstention
comparison_design.future_separate_experiment: Incorrect or conflicting normative documents require separately frozen authority/precedence evidence; without it, alternative norms are not objectively erroneous
not_in_this_batch: repeat of six firmware pilot cases

reference_and_metrics.reference_status: Constructed specification-relative answers, reviewed for consistency; no independently labeled architecture violations
reference_and_metrics.label_table: Report case-by-case expected and predicted labels, and full four-class counts; no weighted quality score
reference_and_metrics.evidence: List cited IDs, whether each supports its claim, omitted required conditions, and unsupported prohibitions; ID existence alone is not entailment
reference_and_metrics.paired_control: Check whether deleting condition evidence changes a previously exception-supported answer into explicit conditional uncertainty
reference_and_metrics.always_unknown_control: Expose abstention baseline with case counts, so caution alone cannot masquerade as successful detection
reference_and_metrics.family_report: Separate the two development families; never count variants as independent samples

tool_model_boundary.tools: Packet separation, hashes, field presence, reference integrity, exact diffs and result accounting
tool_model_boundary.model_or_human: Propose behavior-to-contract applicability and condition reasoning; reasoning must be checked against supplied evidence
tool_model_boundary.provider: Required for future authoritative real-project contracts; current constructed norms do not impersonate provider approval

stop: Close the design batch after input/reference separation and independent review. If examples only test keyword lookup or ambiguity is unresolved, revise admission once or archive unadmitted; do not run for favorable scores.
